target.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Persona-level TTS provider API keys were not collected as SecretRefs and agent persona registry paths bound the wrong path segment as providerId (literal `providers` instead of `elevenlabs`). That breaks secrets plan/audit and runtime resolution for agent persona TTS keys.

Fixes #89607

## Summary

The secret collector walks `messages.tts.providers.*.apiKey` but does not walk `messages.tts.personas.*.providers.*.apiKey` or `agents.list[].tts.personas.*.providers.*.apiKey`. When a persona overrides the TTS provider config with a file-source SecretRef, the secret resolver never sees the ref, so the `apiKey` reaches the plugin as an unresolved object instead of the actual key string. The plugin then reports `not configured`.

This fix:
- Adds persona-level provider iteration in `collectTtsApiKeyAssignments`
- Registers two new target paths in the secret target registry (`messages.tts.personas.*.providers.*.apiKey` and `agents.list[].tts.personas.*.providers.*.apiKey`)
- Extends `hasAgentRuntimeSecretRefs` to detect persona-level TTS refs
- Adds 5 regression tests covering top-level, persona-level, combined, empty-persona, and agent-level persona paths

Closes #89607

## Evidence

Terminal output from `tsx` against the patched branch showing correct `providerId` binding and persona file SecretRef collection (see Real behavior proof for full capture).

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** Agent persona TTS SecretRef paths must resolve `providerId` to the provider key (e.g. `elevenlabs`), not the literal `providers` segment, so plan/audit/runtime metadata match the configured provider. Persona-level file SecretRefs must be collected under `agents.list[].tts.personas.*.providers.*.apiKey`.
- **Real environment tested:** macOS arm64, Node v22, OpenClaw branch `fix/tts-persona-secretref` at `/tmp/oc-89636`, commit after providerId index fix.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**

  ```bash
  cd /tmp/oc-89636
  pnpm exec vitest run src/secrets/target-registry.test.ts src/secrets/runtime-config-collectors-tts.test.ts
  pnpm exec tsx /tmp/proof-tts-providerid.mjs
  pnpm exec tsx /tmp/proof-tts-collect.mjs
  ```

- **Evidence after fix:** terminal output from the patched source:

  ```console
  ✓ src/secrets/target-registry.test.ts (10 tests)
  ✓ src/secrets/runtime-config-collectors-tts.test.ts (5 tests)
  Test Files  2 passed (2)
  Tests  15 passed (15)

  $ pnpm exec tsx /tmp/proof-tts-providerid.mjs
  {"path":"agents.list.0.tts.personas.narrator.providers.elevenlabs.apiKey","entryId":"agents.list[].tts.personas.*.providers.*.apiKey","providerId":"elevenlabs"}
  {"path":"agents.list.0.tts.providers.elevenlabs.apiKey","entryId":"agents.list[].tts.providers.*.apiKey","providerId":"elevenlabs"}
  {"path":"messages.tts.personas.narrator.providers.elevenlabs.apiKey","entryId":"messages.tts.personas.*.providers.*.apiKey","providerId":"elevenlabs"}
  {"path":"messages.tts.providers.elevenlabs.apiKey","entryId":"messages.tts.providers.*.apiKey","providerId":"elevenlabs"}

  $ pnpm exec tsx /tmp/proof-tts-collect.mjs
  assignments:
  {"path":"agents.list.0.tts.personas.narrator.providers.elevenlabs.apiKey","ref":{"source":"file","provider":"default","id":"/tmp/redacted-narrator-key.txt"}}
  ```

- **Observed result after fix:** Registry resolution returns `providerId: "elevenlabs"` for agent persona TTS paths (index 7). Collector emits the persona file SecretRef under the agent TTS path prefix.
- **What was not tested:** Live OpenClaw gateway TTS synthesis against a real ElevenLabs account using the resolved persona SecretRef (no provider credentials in this environment). Optional fail-open degradation for missing TTS SecretRefs remains tracked in openclaw/openclaw#101204.


## Rank-up follow-up (2026-07-09)

ClawSweeper P1: include global persona TTS refs in agent-runtime targets.

- Added `messages.tts.personas.*.providers.*.apiKey` to `STATIC_AGENT_RUNTIME_BASE_TARGET_IDS`
- Extended the agent-runtime target coverage assertion to require both global and agent-level persona paths

Terminal confirmation on branch head:

```console
$ node ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/cli/command-secret-targets.test.ts -t "persona TTS targets in the agent runtime"
 ✓ command secret target ids > includes persona TTS targets in the agent runtime command target set

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed | 39 skipped (40)
```

Still not tested: live `openclaw infer tts convert` with a file-source persona SecretRef (no TTS provider credentials in this environment).
